## What are you trying to do?

Describe what you're trying to accomplish in your own words.

## What happened?

What did you see? Paste any error messages or unexpected output.

## What did you expect?

What did you think would happen?

## What have you tried?

List anything you've already attempted (even if it didn't work — it helps
us narrow things down).
